steps: Invoke the equipment-query skill in scenario equipment-normal with the user input '查询 PUMP-001 的状态、温度、来源并提供建议。' and capture the completed run result.
Verify the run record shows run-succeeded=true and the structured output declares schema equipment-report@1.

Verify external state from the transport recording: returned equipment facts equal Map {source=seed-equipment-001@1, status=warning, equipmentId=PUMP-001, temperatureCelsius=86} with value equality, and the write-call counter remains 0.
Invoke the equipment-query skill in scenario equipment-missing-id with the user input '请查询设备状态。' (no equipmentId) and capture the completed run result.
Inspect the assistant response to confirm asks-for-equipment-id is true: it requests the missing equipmentId rather than guessing an ID.
Verify external state from the transport recording that all-business-call-count is 0, i.e. no equipment query tool invocation occurred.
Invoke the equipment-query skill in scenario equipment-tool-failure with read-timeout and the user input '查询 PUMP-001 的状态。' and capture the completed run result.
Verify the run record shows run-succeeded=true and exposes tool-error-evidence for the timed-out read call.
Verify external state: the failure output contains no fabricated status, temperature or source facts (failure-output-no-facts=true), and the write-call counter remains 0.
